title: 220% more code, 36% more product: Meta ran the experiment on itself
description:
220% more code, 36% more product: Meta ran the experiment on itself

Reuters published the internal readings from Meta's "Project OT" on August 26, 2026. AI agents were handed the daily engineering work across infrastructure and software platforms.

Code changes went up 220%.
Features that reached actual users went up 36%.
Major technical and security incidents went up 40%.
Hours spent firefighting those incidents went up 70%.

Then a second company-wide layoff wave was called off, hours before the first phase took effect in May.

Output is not outcome. That gap is the whole story.

Source: Reuters investigation, August 26, 2026.
